variant.description:
ProxyPlayer is a simple plugin that allows you to control your Windows or Linux* PC's media playback from within XIV.
> * - Linux support is only supported on official XIVLauncher Wine builds and certain Wine/Proton builds with "AF_UNIX" support.

Control your media player from within the game, without having to alt-tab or use a second monitor.
Features (depending on your media player):
- Play/Pause
- Next/Previous Track
- Stop
- Progress Bar
- Cover Art Display
- Metadata

ProxyPlayer comes with either a compact or portrait UI for displaying your media information.
variant.name: ProxyPlayer
variant.punchline: Control what's playing on your computer within XIV!
